plan.description: Read the input single-cell RNA-seq dataset in h5ad format using Scanpy. This step initializes the analysis by loading the AnnData object containing expression data, cell barcodes, and gene names from the provided sarcoma dataset. The output is an AnnData object ready for quality control.
input_filename: /cs/student/projects2/aisd/2024/shekchu/projects/cell_agents/remove_label/sarcoma_dataset_restricted.h5ad: A single-cell RNA-seq dataset containing gene expression profiles with cell barcodes and gene names.
output_filename: ./output/o3_sarcoma/initial_data.h5ad: initial AnnData object after reading the sarcoma dataset

plan.description: Perform quality control (QC) filtering to remove low-quality cells. Use Scanpy functions (such as filtering based on mitochondrial gene percentage, total UMIs, and number of detected genes) to identify and retain high-quality cells. The resulting QC-filtered AnnData object reduces noise for downstream analyses.
input_filename: ./output/o3_sarcoma/initial_data.h5ad: initial AnnData object after reading the sarcoma dataset
output_filename: ./output/o3_sarcoma/qc_filtered.h5ad: AnnData object after quality control filtering

plan.description: Normalize the QC-passed data and identify highly variable genes. This step involves normalizing total counts per cell, applying a logarithmic transformation, and selecting genes with high variance across cells using Scanpy. This normalization prepares the data for reliable clustering and downstream analysis.
input_filename: ./output/o3_sarcoma/qc_filtered.h5ad: AnnData object after quality control filtering
output_filename: ./output/o3_sarcoma/normalized_data.h5ad: AnnData object with normalized expression values and identified highly variable genes

plan.description: Perform dimensionality reduction and clustering analysis. Use PCA for dimensionality reduction and compute a neighborhood graph followed by Leiden clustering. Additionally, generate UMAP or t-SNE visualizations. The output is an AnnData object annotated with cluster labels, which are critical for subsequent malignant vs. non-malignant classification.
input_filename: ./output/o3_sarcoma/normalized_data.h5ad: AnnData object with normalized expression values and HVGs
output_filename: ./output/o3_sarcoma/clustering_results.h5ad: AnnData object with clustering labels and dimensionality reduction results

plan.description: Identify marker genes for each cluster by performing differential expression analysis. Using Scanpy's ranking functions (e.g. scanpy.tl.rank_genes_groups), determine statistically significant genes that distinguish clusters. This marker gene information is critical to infer which clusters likely represent malignant cells based on known markers or expression patterns.
output_filename: ./output/o3_sarcoma/marker_genes.txt: Text file containing marker genes with associated statistical metrics (logFC, p-values, adjusted p-values)

plan.description: Classify cells as malignant or non-malignant based on the marker gene analysis. Annotate the AnnData object by integrating marker gene expression information and cluster identities to assign a label (malignant or non-malignant) to each cell. Finally, save the fully annotated cell dataset in h5ad format, allowing for further analyses and visualization.
input_filename: ./output/o3_sarcoma/clustering_results.h5ad: AnnData object with clustering labels and marker gene information
output_filename: ./output/o3_sarcoma/cell_classification.h5ad: Final annotated AnnData object with cell malignancy labels (malignant or non-malignant)
